description: Key figures per fiscal year or quarter from a company's SEC XBRL filings, the numbers it tagged itself: revenue, net income, operating income, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, diluted EPS and shares outstanding. Each value carries the form and filing date it came from. Ticker or CIK. Source: SEC XBRL API, public domain. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sec_events when you need to list a US company's latest 8-K filings and their items; sec_filings when you need to list recent SEC EDGAR filings for a company. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: sec_financials
title: Key figures per fiscal year or quarter from a company's SEC
